assertions.name: difference_links_are_composite_not_single_hyperbolic
assertions.source: every difference link closes to a multi-cusp manifold that stays 'degenerate tetrahedra' at high precision — composite (JSJ), not one hyperbolic knot; rigorous decomposition is Sage-gated

description: Classification of the binding difference knot D = W_atom·W_free⁻¹ (PR #2235 follow-up): cusp count (link components) + high-precision volume + solution type. Finding: the difference links are composite (2A−1 cusps; persistently 'degenerate tetrahedra' even at high precision) — not single hyperbolic knots. Records the two blockers gating rigorous promotion: (1) the JSJ decomposition / interval-verified volumes are Sage-only in SnapPy (unavailable here); (2) the amplification-vs-mass-table test is tautological because production m_pred = Σ m_nucleon − B_pred is circular. Diagnostic only.

data.blocker_option2_jsj: SAGE-ONLY: verify_hyperbolicity / canonical_retriangulation / splitting_surfaces unavailable in plain SnapPy; rigorous JSJ volume sum needs Sage or a manual decomposition.
data.blocker_option3_amplification_test: TAUTOLOGICAL: production m_pred = Σ m_nucleon − B_pred is circular, so binding_err ≈ (M/B)·mass_err re-derives prop:binding-error-amplification rather than confirming it; an independent test needs the bound mass from m_e·Vol(K)·ρ(K)/ℏ_q² with per-knot Vol(K).
